title: How to Conduct a Strategy Review
coreMove: Run a strategy review that changes the plan by forcing sharper questions and commitments.
sourcePressure: Strategy review: the meeting has to pressure the plan through questions about competition, capability, focus, idea choice, people linkage, operations linkage, and follow-through. No chapter-specific named review case is frozen.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Make the review a polite presentation, status meeting, or critique session.

hook: the how to conduct a strategy review that nobody sees until it is too late
a meeting room where every plan sounds good
a generic promise colliding with reality
counterintuition: Most leaders think X, but the opposite is true
The problem is not effort, it is discipline
Execution is not about working harder
tryThisNow: set a timer and write three priorities
audit one goal in your notebook
ask yourself what matters most today
examples: generic project kickoff with vague owners
student team with a deadline and no specificity
family calendar scene used as a management analogy

exampleSpecs.domain: a regional bank reviewing a small-business lending strategy after defaults rise in one sector
exampleSpecs.audience: a credit leader running a review
exampleSpecs.stakes: a polished lending plan can ignore competition and sector risk until losses deepen
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Grace asks how well the team knows the new fintech competitor and the sector defaults, turning the review from presentation into pressure
exampleSpecs.firstImage: "Which lender is taking the low-risk borrowers from us?" Grace asks before the first slide changes.

exampleSpecs.domain: a regional theater reviewing a subscription strategy with too many audience initiatives
exampleSpecs.audience: an artistic director and board finance chair
exampleSpecs.stakes: scattered ideas can drain rehearsal budgets and still miss younger subscribers
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Ryan marks every initiative on the season wall and makes the room choose which ideas deserve capacity
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Colored sticky notes cover the season wall until the rehearsal budget line nearly disappears.

exampleSpecs.domain: a university IT office reviewing a cloud migration plan without enough database administrators
exampleSpecs.stakes: migration dates can look strong while organizational capability is weak
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Vincent must decide whether to let the review proceed before testing capability and people linkage
exampleSpecs.firstImage: At 9:03 a.m., Vincent sees the migration timeline glowing green and the DBA roster showing two vacancies.

exampleSpecs.domain: a specialty coffee roaster reviewing expansion into airports while existing cafe quality is uneven
exampleSpecs.audience: a founder leading a strategy review
exampleSpecs.stakes: a new channel can amplify an operating weakness the review is avoiding
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Lars traces the airport delay to a review that praised growth but never linked operations to quality capacity
exampleSpecs.firstImage: It took Lars three airport-site visits to admit the cupping defect sheet had belonged in the review.

exampleSpecs.domain: a regional mental-health charity reviewing a telehealth plan with unclear clinician schedules
exampleSpecs.stakes: clients can be offered appointments the staffing pattern cannot sustain
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Catarina asks what changes after the review, then forces a narrower plan with clinician schedules attached
exampleSpecs.firstImage: What should be different on Monday if a strategy review has actually done its job?

exampleSpecs.domain: a Toronto robotics supplier reviewing three attractive product ideas after a competitor undercuts price
exampleSpecs.stakes: choosing the wrong idea can consume scarce engineering hours
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Min changes the review from idea admiration to right-idea selection by tying each option to competition, capability, and follow-through
exampleSpecs.firstImage: You have three prototype photos on the table, and Min has only twelve engineering weeks to spend.

skillTargets: turn review questions toward competition, capability, focus, idea choice, linkages, and follow-through
distinguish presentation protection from plan pressure
choose the question that changes commitments after the meeting
evaluate whether review produced sharper action

tryThisNowSpec: Before your next review, write one question that could change the plan, not merely explain it.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person 'You' direct address, retrospective 'It took her three weeks to see', question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm: a question to the reader, a research aside, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical reference
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following the pattern 'concrete anchor sentence -> abstract rule sentence -> elaboration sentence'
